|gr1= GUI Control - Map

|gr2= Positions

|descr= Converts world coordinates into map screen coordinates. This command is identical to [[ctrlMapWorldToScreen]].

|s1= map [[posWorldToScreen]] position

|p1= map : [[Control]] - map control

|p2= position : [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position3D]] - world position

|r1= [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] - screen coordinates in format [x, y]

|x1= <sqf>_screenCoord = _control posWorldToScreen _worldCoord;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>_screenCoord = _control posWorldToScreen position player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[posScreenToWorld]] [[ctrlMapWorldToScreen]]
